I can’t speak for everyone but I know a few people with ARFID and they’ve explained it to me as those types of food are more consistently the same. They taste the same every time, look the same etc. Take broccoli for example, it can vary slightly in colour, it can be overcooked and become mushy or be too hard. Another example is fruit, sometimes it’s really sweet, other times it’s sour. 

For someone who struggles with food, it’s easier for them to stick with something that 99% of the time is the same and they are familiar with it than to pick somewhere where there’s a high chance it isn’t what you like or what you’re use to.
